Role Summary

Revamp is seeking an Engineering Project Manager to lead engineering delivery for EPC clients building utility-scale solar PV and BESS projects. Every project you manage brings more clean power to the grid, and your leadership determines how smoothly it moves from design to construction. You will run several projects at once with full ownership of their outcomes, and clients and our engineering teams will rely on you for clear direction on scope and next steps. You will bring our civil, electrical, structural, and power systems engineers together around a shared plan and earn client confidence through sound judgment and transparent communication.

You will join a mission-driven team accelerating the energy transition, where collaboration and trust shape how we work with clients and with each other. As an employee-owner, you will share directly in the success of the firm and the projects you help deliver.

Duties & Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own project scopes, schedules, and budgets from kickoff through closeout.
  • Manage multiple smaller projects or several complex projects simultaneously.
  • Coordinate and manage internal discipline teams and external subconsultants to ensure timely and accurate deliverables.
  • Prepare, track, and submit monthly project invoicing.
  • Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts.
  • Ensure projects comply with client requirements, contractual obligations, and Revamp quality standards.
  • Prepare and review project scopes, budgets, schedules, and work plans.
  • Review complete project documents for conformity, quality assurance, and contractual compliance.
  • Apply standard project management procedures and criteria with independent judgment.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects.
  • Lead and participate in project meetings with clients, internal teams, and subcontractors.

  • Review client standards, best practices, and project-specific requirements and ensure alignment across teams.
  • Assist with proposal development, including scope definition, budgeting, and scheduling inputs.

Collaboration & Team Support

  • Assign tasks to and direct discipline team members to complete project assignments.
  • Plan and coordinate detailed aspects of engineering work in collaboration with technical leads.
  • Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced project and engineering staff.
  • Support a collaborative, accountable, and transparent project team environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting project deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related field or an associate’s degree in a related field plus substantial relevant industry experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years of project management experience in an engineering consulting environment, renewable energy, or similar industry.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project scopes, schedules, budgets, and invoicing.
  • Ability to independently evaluate, select, and apply standard project management procedures.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to identify, analyze, and solve complex project issues.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a high standard for accuracy and quality.

Preferred

  • Substantial experience in renewable energy engineering, development, or construction environments.
  • Familiarity with the renewable energy project development lifecycle.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and subconsultants.

  • Full benefits package including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.

  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. About Bowery Valuation

Bowery Valuation is redefining the commercial real estate appraisal industry through technology, data, and exceptional talent. As one of the fastest-growing appraisal firms in the country, Bowery combines cutting-edge valuation technology with a national team of expert appraisers to deliver a better experience for clients and employees alike. Bowery writes appraisal reports that assess the value of commercial properties - such as hotels and apartment complexes - for hundreds of active clients.

Position Overview

We are seeking an AR Lead to run an accounts receivable clean up and help improve our accounts receivable process, DSO, and outstanding balance. You will join our lean, collaborative accounting team, working directly to the Accounting Manager, and work closely with the accounting, business development, and appraisal teams to ensure invoices are paid accurately and on time.

This is not a light-touch collections role. As a transactional, B2B business with hundreds of active clients and widely varied payment processes, our AR cycle is a complex, multi-step process that requires diligence, organization, and consistent follow-through. We are looking for someone who wants to help with this function with a high degree of ownership — and who treats the AR balance as their number for those clients which have been assigned to them.

You will also work with our technology system to automate portions of client reach-outs, helping shape and streamline the collections workflow.

Note: This is a remote role for a U.S.-based independent contractor.

Hours & Compensation

  • Estimated 10–20 hours per week.
  • Compensation: $40–60 per hour, depending on experience.
  • Ongoing contract with no fixed end date. We are looking for someone to partner with for the long term.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end accounts receivable cycle for assigned clients, with a primary focus on client outreach and collections.
  • Proactively research and identify the appropriate point of contact within client organizations for each invoice.
  • Communicate professionally, clearly, and collaboratively with clients via email to resolve outstanding payments.
  • Collaborate closely with the Accounting Manager, business development team, and appraisers to clarify invoice details and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor the overall AR balance and drive it down through consistent, organized follow-up.
  • Manage a high volume of client accounts and follow-ups with diligence and attention to detail.
  • Support payment application and reconciliation as needed.
  • Use our upcoming automation system for client reach-outs, and help streamline AR workflows as new tools are rolled out.
  • Flag recurring issues or patterns in payment delays to leadership.
  • Take on additional accounting tasks over time as the role evolves.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience owning accounts receivable end to end in a B2B, transactional business (rather than a subscription-based model).
  • An ownership mindset: you want to run this function, not just work a queue, and you bring the diligence a complex collections process requires.
  • Accounting background or degree is a strong plus.
  • Experience with an ERP or accounting software (NetSuite is a plus, not required).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate professionally yet naturally with clients.
  • Highly organized, personable, and collaborative working style.
  • Comfortable working core hours aligned with U.S. Eastern Time.
  • Based in the United States and authorized to work as an independent contractor.
  • Genuine interest in AR/collections work.

This role requires deep engineering expertise, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to drive technical execution across multiple systems.   9. Provide Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, and collaborate with Product, AI/ML, Data, and Operations to deliver scalable solutions.

Overview

As a Product Manager II, you'll drive two connected areas at the center of how enablement and marketing teams create the materials that guide human and AI sellers.

The Pages platform. You'll own Seismic's dynamic webpage-building platform, the foundation behind Pages, Plays, and Digital Sales Rooms. This is detailed, craft-heavy product work. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with UX design and Engineering on the decisions that make a page building and consumption great: layout, composition, re-usable components, and templates. You'll obsess over the details of the authoring experience, from the editing canvas to brand controls, while exploring how AI can make it dramatically easier to create polished, personalized experiences. And you'll tackle the unique challenge of enterprise sales enablement: giving teams creative freedom while ensuring everything they build is on-brand, governed, and easy to scale.

AI content creation. You'll create AI solutions that help marketers and enablers quickly and dynamically produce engaging enablement materials across formats, through a unified flow that speeds generation and makes it easy to deploy and optimize enablement for the field. That content will appear first in Seismic, but it also forms a trusted content layer that informs agents and agentic experiences within Seismic and everywhere sales teams work. And you'll close the loop: figuring out how to use AI, adoption data and context to help page creators improve their content based on what's working on the ground.

The most compelling part of this role is the intersection of three disciplines:

  • Creative tooling: making sophisticated design and content creation feel effortless.
  • Interaction design: obsessing over the small details that make an editor intuitive, fast, and enjoyable.
  • Enterprise workflows: adapting those capabilities to the needs of sales and marketing teams, including governance, reuse, personalization, and scale.

All of it incorporates the latest AI practices to simplify workflows and help creators accelerate, without losing control.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll dig into customer problems, make the call on what to build, and own the results: adoption, retention, and the outcomes our customers see.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years of product management experience building user-facing products (B2B or B2C), including taking one or more key features to market successfully.
  • Strong specification and delivery skills. You write clear specs with the right level of detail, make sound tradeoff decisions with your team, and know when to escalate.
  • Design sensibility. You can assess a user experience, give specific and constructive feedback, and work comfortably with designers on layout, interaction, and visual detail.
  • Fluency with data. You can define instrumentation, analyze results, and use what you learn to set realistic goals and recommend next steps.
  • Technical curiosity. You can have productive conversations with engineers about front-end architecture, LLMs, and data, and you're eager to go deeper.
  • An AI-forward way of working. You use AI regularly to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
  • Clear communication. You bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you, and keep your manager and stakeholders well informed.
  • Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus points

  • You've shipped AI-powered features and know what it takes to make them reliable.
  • You've worked on a page builder, website builder, CMS, design tool, or other no-code creation product, or a product with theming and brand-customization requirements.
  • You've worked on enablement, sales, marketing, or content-management software.

Why This Role

  • A category being rewritten. AI is changing how content gets made and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
  • Ownership that's real. You'll drive a key product area with the accountability and room to grow that come with it.
  • Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams, marketers, and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
  • A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own outcomes, not output. Set clear goals and success metrics tied to adoption, retention, and customer results. Follow through after launch, report honestly on what happened, and recommend the next step.
  • Own the Pages platform roadmap that powers key Seismic Pages, Plays, Digital Sales Rooms, and other native content types: critical user-experience infrastructure for the whole product.
  • Create AI solutions that empower creators. Help users quickly and dynamically build engaging enablement materials across formats to guide human and AI sellers, delivering a trusted content layer for agents inside Seismic and wherever sales teams work.
  • Love the problem. Talk with enablement leaders, marketers, and sellers regularly. Run discovery with design and research, and test prototypes early, so you're confident a solution is valuable, usable, viable, and feasible before the team builds it.
  • Set the quality bar for AI. Define evals and quality standards that make AI-generated content accurate, on-brand, and trustworthy, and use them to decide when something is ready to ship.
  • Ship in small, measurable increments. Make smart tradeoffs between speed and quality, triage issues, and make the call on launch readiness.

      <title>Current: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Front-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (US)
</p>

<h3>&nbsp;</h3>
<h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.</p>
<h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.</li>
<li>Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.</li>
<li>Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.</li>
<li>Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.</li>
<li>QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.</li>
<li>Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.</li>
<li>Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.</li>
<li>Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.</li>
<li>Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.</li>
<li>Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>Required</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.</li>
<li>Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.</li>
<li>Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.</li>
<li>Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.</li>
<li>A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.</li>
<li>Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.</li>
<li>Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.</li>
<li>Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.</li>
<li>Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.</li>
<li>Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).</li>
<li>Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.</li>
<li>Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).</li>
<li>Agency or consulting experience.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Why Current</strong></h2>
<p>At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.</p>
<p>We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.</p>
<p>You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.</p>
<p>This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.</p>

</description>

      <title>Clover Health: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<p>Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention &amp; Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.</p>
<p>This is a non-attorney role.&nbsp; You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.</p>
<p><strong>As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention &amp; Investigations, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: </strong>Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.</li>
<li><strong>Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: </strong>Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions.&nbsp; Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Build Defensible Documentation: </strong>Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborate Across Functions: </strong>Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.</li>
<li><strong>Communicate Findings Clearly: </strong>Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Success in this role looks like:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>In your first 90 days</strong>, you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.</li>
<li><strong>By 6 months</strong>, you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.</li>
<li><strong>By 12 months</strong>, you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You should get in touch if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes &amp; investigative experience: </strong>You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care.&nbsp; You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.</li>
<li><strong>You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs:</strong> You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. <em>We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work.</em></li>
<li><strong>Strong communication skills: </strong>You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide.</li>
<li>You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance.</li>
<li>You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan.</li>
<li>You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p><strong>Benefits Overview</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Financial Well-Being</strong>: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.</li>
<li><strong>Physical Well-Being</strong>: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.</li>
<li><strong>Mental Well-Being</strong>: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Professional Development</strong>: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Additional Perks:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities</li>
<li>Reimbursement for office setup expenses</li>
<li>Monthly cell phone &amp; internet stipend</li>
<li>Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams</li>
<li>Paid parental leave for all new parents</li>
<li>And much more!</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p><strong>About Clover: </strong>We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.</p>
<p>We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.</p>
<p>From Clover’s inception, Diversity &amp; Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.</p>
<hr>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p>
<p><em>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an</em><a href="https://e-verify.uscis.gov/esp/media/resourcesContents/E-Verify_Participation_Poster.pdf"><em> </em><em>E-Verify</em></a><em> company.</em></p>
<div class="c-virtual_list__item">
<div class="c-message_kit__background c-message_kit__background--hovered p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message">

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for the Product Platform team, which owns the foundational layer of our API that all other Lithic products build on top. The team’s mission is to make Lithic's API the best in fintech — reliable, consistent, and a joy to integrate with. This includes API Gateway, Events Platform, API key management and authorization, audit logging, or API norms and versioning strategy.</p>

<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City, Remote
</p>

<h2>Alloy is where you belong!</h2>
<p>Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.<br><br>Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of <a href="https://www.inc.com/profile/alloy_ny">Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces</a>, <a href="https://www.forbes.com/companies/alloy/?list=americas-best-startup-employers&amp;sh=55c076453c61">Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers</a>, <a href="https://www.americanbanker.com/list/best-places-to-work-in-fintech-2022">Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker</a>, year after year.<br><br>Check out our investors and read more about us <a href="https://www.alloy.com/about">here</a>.</p>
<h2>About the team</h2>
<p>We're standing up a new function at Alloy: Forward Deployed Engineering. Our largest enterprise customers need a trusted technical partner with a strong point of view on how Alloy fits into their tech stack and fraud strategy. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll be that partner - embedded with our most strategic accounts and owning the technical outcome end-to-end, with each deployment becoming the foundation for the next.</p>
<p>You'll be one of the first two engineers on this founding team. This is a software engineering role through and through - based within our Engineering org, with a scope that spans software, product, and solutions engineering. You won't just join this function - you'll define how it works.</p>
<p>Alloy operates in a hybrid-work environment. We look to foster collaboration and community by having our local employees onsite three days a week.</p>
<h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Architect and tune customer and channel-partner deployments end-to-end — API integrations, third-party data integrations, SDKs, and latency constraints.</li>
<li>Write production code across our stack: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6/React), Python (Django), Node.js, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and AWS.</li>
<li>Serve as Alloy's credible technical voice with customer engineering leadership, making architectural calls in real time.</li>
<li>Own the engineering track of QBRs for your accounts and serve in their on-call escalation path.</li>
<li>Turn your work into reusable platform primitives and docs, so each deployment makes the next one faster.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who we’re looking for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of hands-on experience developing production-ready software, with a proven track record of delivering robust, scalable solutions.</li>
<li>Experience in a customer-facing technical role, Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering with deep technical ownership, or similar - where you were accountable to an external stakeholder, not just an internal roadmap.</li>
<li>Strong backend and API fluency, with the ability to read and write production code across services you don't own.</li>
<li>Sound architectural judgment under ambiguity: you can make and defend technical decisions in the room, with a customer watching.</li>
<li>A genuine pull toward customer-facing work - you find energy in solving a real customer's real problem, alongside their engineers.</li>
<li>A clear technical communicator who can explain a complex integration tradeoff to a bank's VP of Engineering and to an Alloy PM in the same afternoon.</li>
<li>Ability to travel on occasion to our NYC office, as well as client offices in the US.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company with a strong Forward Deployed Engineering culture (Palantir, Scale AI, Ramp, Plaid, Stripe, etc.).</li>
<li>Familiarity with identity, fraud, KYC/KYB, or financial services infrastructure.</li>
<li>Experience with SDK development or embedded front-end integrations.</li>
</ul>
<p>We're a lean team, so your impact will be felt immediately, and opportunities will grow as the company scales up. If this all sounds like a good fit for you, why not join us?</p>
<p>Alloy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Below is the anticipated starting base compensation range for this role; however, pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, in-demand skills, relevant experience, and/or geography. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is also eligible for equity awards in the form of stock options (ISOs) as well as a competitive total benefits package. Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details and what compensation could look like for you specifically!</p>
<p><em>This position has a salary range of $141,000 to $250,000.&nbsp;</em></p>
<h2>Benefits and Perks&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO and flexible work policy</li>
<li>Employee stock options</li>
<li>Medical, dental, vision plans with HSA (monthly employer contribution) and FSA options</li>
<li>401k with 100% match up to 4% of annual employee compensation&nbsp;</li>
<li>Eligible new parents receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Home office stipend for new employees</li>
<li>Annual Learning &amp; Development annual stipend</li>
<li>Well-being benefits include access to ClassPass, OneMedical, UrbanSitter, and Spring Health&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2>How to apply</h2>
<p>Apply right here! You've found the application!</p>

We’re committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience and provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with visible and invisible disabilities. We encourage applicants to share needed accommodations with their recruiter.</p>
<p>All Alloy jobs are listed on our careers page. Any communication during the recruitment process, including interview requests or job offers, will come directly from a recruiting team member with an <a href="http://alloy.com/">alloy.com</a> email address. We do not use outside applications or automated text messaging in our recruiting process. We will not ask for any sensitive financial or identification information during the recruiting process. If you’re ever unsure, please contact us directly via our website before sharing personal information.</p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote- USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span>Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span><strong>The Community You Will Join: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>As an Operations Engineer, you'll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech's operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You'll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect</li>
<li>Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time</li>
<li>Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead</li>
<li>Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows</li>
<li>Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution</li>
</ul>
<p><br><span><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch)</li>
<li>3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS)</li>
<li>Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto)</li>
<li>Experience with Infrastructure as Code</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud</li>
<li>Comfort working in ticket/workflow-driven environments using Jira and Confluence</li>
<li>Experience supporting enterprise SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, Workday) and SSO/identity integration (e.g., Okta) is a plus</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Your Location</strong></p>
<p>This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity.<a href="https://careers.airbnb.com/"> Click here</a> for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.</p>
<p><span><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p>
<p><span><span>We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: </span><a href="mailto:reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com"><span>reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com</span></a><span>. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><span>We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.</span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity: </strong></p>
<p>Airbnb values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span><strong><span>How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p>

      <title>Squarespace: Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City; Remote
</p>

<p>Squarespace is seeking a talented Staff Software Engineer to support and evolve the systems at the core core of our monetization platform: billing, payments and orders. In this role, you will provide technical oversight over the critical monetization machinery that accepts orders, processes payments and bills subscriptions. You will regularly collaborate with engineering leadership and key product, strategy and finance stakeholders to align technical strategy with Squarespace’s business objectives. This is an opportunity to take on IC technical leadership responsibilities and own system architecture for high-visibility initiatives tied directly to Squarespace's core businesses.</p>
<p>This role is open to remote or hybrid working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the Director of Revenue Systems.</p>
<h2><strong>You'll Get To...</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own system architectural vision and design for critical areas of our business.</li>
<li>Transform high-level system vision into estimated project plans for initiatives central to Squarespace’s strategy.</li>
<li>Serve as technical lead and cross-functional liaison on business-critical projects, making and defending engineering decisions key to the success of the business.</li>
<li>Mentor engineers on the team to deliver ever greater quality with ever growing autonomy.</li>
<li>Drive best practices for engineering excellence and technical leadership, influence design reviews, question assumptions, point out pitfalls and foster shared understanding</li>
<li>Set the engineering quality bar for the team through regular, high-quality code contributions across billing, orders and payments.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>10 or more years experience specifying, delivering and maintaining complex distributed backend services.</li>
<li>Significant experience with multiple programming languages (especially Java) and a broad range of tools like Springboot, hibernate, databases, etc.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading system architecture decisions across multiple teams or initiatives</li>
<li>Proven ability to serve as a technical lead on cross-functional projects, aligning engineering and business goals without sacrificing engineering quality</li>
<li>Experience working with billing, orders or payment systems at scale</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision</li>
<li>Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans</li>
<li>Fertility and adoption benefits</li>
<li>Headspace mindfulness app subscription</li>
<li>Global Employee Assistance Program</li>
<li>Retirement benefits with employer match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave</li>
<li>Pretax commuter benefit</li>
<li>Education reimbursement</li>
<li>Employee donation match to community organizations</li>
<li>7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)</li>
<li>Dog-friendly workplace</li>
<li>Free lunch and snacks</li>
<li>Private rooftop</li>
<li>Hack week twice per year</li>
</ul>
<h3>Cash Compensation Range: $170,000 - $299,000 USD</h3>
<p>The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.</p>
<p>In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.</p>
<h2><strong>About Squarespace</strong></h2>
<p>Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit <a href="https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers">https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers</a>.</p>
<h2><strong>Our Commitment</strong></h2>
<p>Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. At Squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.</p>

      <title>Dremio: Staff Software Engineer - Connectivity</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>Dremio's Connectivity team builds the high-performance connectivity solutions that help customers bring data to Dremio and connect Dremio to the broader data ecosystem. The team works across client drivers, protocols, connectors, interoperability, distributed systems, and the reliability and supportability of production data access.</p>
<p>As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll independently own multiple medium-to-large features or service components within a Connectivity and Clients area. You'll define the approach for a substantial team-area scope, turn ambiguous goals into clear milestones, make sound feature and service-level design decisions, and drive work through reliable production delivery. You will bring deep expertise in at least one area, such as JDBC or ODBC drivers, Apache Arrow ADBC, Arrow Flight SQL, BI interoperability, source connectivity, or connectivity reliability, while contributing effectively across adjacent areas. You will also mentor engineers and influence partner teams through strong technical judgment and execution.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own substantial connectivity work:</strong> Lead multiple medium-to-large features or service components from problem definition through design, implementation, validation, release readiness, and operational handoff.</li>
<li><strong>Turn ambiguity into an execution plan:</strong> Define reviewable milestones, acceptance measures, dependencies, estimates, and risks for complex customer, product, and engineering goals.</li>
<li><strong>Design scalable, maintainable systems:</strong> Produce technical designs and architecture diagrams, explain trade-offs, and make feature and service-level decisions across drivers, protocols, client libraries, connectors, and distributed services.</li>
<li><strong>Diagnose complex failures:</strong> Lead root-cause analysis across client/server, protocol, network, authentication, metadata, and distributed-system boundaries using logs, telemetry, profiles, benchmarks, and production evidence.</li>
<li><strong>Build compatibility and reliability:</strong> Maintain API and protocol stability; create automated compatibility, interoperability, performance, scale, reliability, observability, and diagnostics coverage; and define practical migration paths for supported and legacy clients.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborate and influence:</strong> Partner with Product, Query Execution, QA, Support, SRE, Documentation, and external technology partners to resolve dependencies and improve certification, customer experience, and supportability.</li>
<li><strong>Raise the engineering bar:</strong> Participate actively in code and design reviews, mentor and coach engineers, improve team practices, and contribute to relevant upstream open-source projects when aligned with Dremio priorities.</li>
<li><strong>Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly:</strong> Apply Dremio-approved AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation while protecting proprietary and customer data and validating results through review, testing, and sound engineering judgment.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Staff-level ownership:</strong> 8+ years of production software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through sustained ownership of complex systems and multiple substantial team-area features.</li>
<li><strong>Programming expertise:</strong> Deep proficiency in Java, C++, Rust, Go, or another systems or services language, with the ability to work effectively in adjacent languages and frameworks.</li>
<li><strong>Connectivity and systems depth:</strong> Experience designing and debugging APIs, protocols, client libraries, drivers, or distributed services, with strong knowledge of data structures, concurrency, asynchronous programming, networking, and failure handling.</li>
<li><strong>Problem-solving ability:</strong> Able to identify and solve non-obvious problems across client/server and distributed-system boundaries and turn findings into durable fixes and regression coverage.</li>
<li><strong>Quality mindset:</strong> Experience building comprehensive unit, integration, compatibility, performance, or reliability tests and working with production CI/CD, packaging, release, certification, and engineering quality controls.</li>
<li><strong>Communication and influence:</strong> Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, surface risks early, align contributors across teams, and influence without formal authority.</li>
<li><strong>Mentorship:</strong> Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers and improve the effectiveness and engineering practices of the team around you.</li>
<li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees and equivalent industry experience are welcomed.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience developing JDBC, ODBC, ADBC, or other database drivers.</li>
<li>Experience with Apache Arrow or Arrow Flight SQL.</li>
<li>Experience with SQL engines, databases, data platforms, or source connectors.</li>
<li>BI interoperability experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools, including collaboration with partner engineering teams.</li>
<li>Knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, TLS, enterprise authentication, metadata discovery, or query pushdown.</li>
<li>Cross-platform native build, packaging, release engineering, compatibility certification, or upgrade support experience.</li>
<li>Observability, production diagnostics, customer escalation, long-running data transfer, cancellation, keepalive, timeout, or proxy experience.</li>
<li>Contributions to Apache Arrow or other relevant open-source projects.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click </span></em><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CB96QFmOX-bFy48YFOe2GO5lmdawOpKKBj8DpTgsuNg/edit?usp=sharing"><em><span>here</span></em></a><em><span> to review the privacy notice.&nbsp;</span></em></p>
<h3><strong>Important Security Notice for Candidates</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement&nbsp;<a href="https://www.dremio.com/blog/stay-alert-for-fraudulent-recruitment-attempts-that-falsely-claim-association-with-dremio/">here</a>.</span></p>
<p><em>Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.</em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/dremio-staff-software-engineer-connectivity">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/dremio-staff-software-engineer-connectivity</a></p>
</description>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0017/1267/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Ghent - Belgium
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.twikey.com/jobs">https://www.twikey.com/jobs</a>
</p>

<p>Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.</p>
<p><strong>Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.</strong></p>
<p>Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.</p>
<p>Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.</p>
<p>As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.</p>
<ul>
<li>You focus on&nbsp;<strong>developing and improving the back-end</strong>&nbsp;of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.</li>
<li>With your expertise you'll&nbsp;<strong>make valuable suggestions and streamline processes</strong>&nbsp;for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.</li>
<li>You provide&nbsp;<strong>technical support on integration projects</strong>&nbsp;with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.</li>
</ul>
<p>Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.</p>
<h4 class="sec-title-9">What are we looking for in you?</h4>
<ul>
<li>You are&nbsp;<strong>driven, curious and enterprising.</strong>&nbsp;Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a&nbsp;<strong>pro-active attitude</strong>&nbsp;and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.</li>
<li>Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to&nbsp;<strong>learn</strong>. You're a&nbsp;<strong>self-starter</strong>&nbsp;and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.</li>
<li>You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that&nbsp;<strong>mix of creating and fine-tuning</strong>. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.</li>
<li>You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're&nbsp;<strong>actively exploring how AI can contribute</strong>&nbsp;to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.</li>
<li>You therefore attach&nbsp;<strong>a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability</strong>&nbsp;of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.</li>
<li>You have demonstrable experience with&nbsp;<strong>Java, Go and the Spring framework</strong>. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.</li>
<li>You have&nbsp;<strong>a deep understanding of databases.</strong>&nbsp;You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.</li>
<li>You have a very good command of&nbsp;<strong>English</strong>, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.</li>
<li>You are based in a time zone within&nbsp;<strong>one hour of CET</strong>, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.</li>
<li>You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="sec-title-9">Twikey offers you:</h4>
<ul>
<li>An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.</li>
<li>The room to&nbsp;<strong>experiment, to challenge and to improve.</strong>&nbsp;And we expect you to really take that room.</li>
<li>An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!</li>
<li>A&nbsp;<strong>complementary team of more than 35 colleagues</strong>&nbsp;who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.</li>
<li>A motivating workplace with&nbsp;<strong>plenty of knowledge and expertise</strong>, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.</li>
<li><strong>Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue.</strong>&nbsp;Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!</li>
<li>A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.</li>
<li>A&nbsp;<strong>salary package tailored</strong>&nbsp;to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.</li>
<li>The chance to work in an&nbsp;<strong>innovative Belgian fintech scale-up</strong>&nbsp;that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!</li>
</ul>
<p>A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you&nbsp;<a class="link" href="https://www.twikey.com/jobs/testimonials.html">here</a> what it's really like to work at Twikey.</p>

      <title>Mixpanel: Customer Value Architect III</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mixpanel</strong></p>
<p>Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at <a href="https://mixpanel.com/home/">mixpanel.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p>
<p>The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure.</li>
<li>Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most.</li>
<li>Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates.</li>
<li>Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both.</li>
<li>Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.</li>
<li>Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early.</li>
<li>Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer.</li>
<li>Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team.</li>
<li>Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data.</li>
<li>Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>We're Looking For Someone Who Has</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience.</li>
<li>A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams.</li>
<li>The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI.</li>
<li>Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots.</li>
<li>A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward.</li>
<li>Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.</li>
<li>Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity.</li>
<li>Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong><strong><br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care</li>
<li>Mental Wellness Benefit</li>
<li>Generous Vacation Policy &amp; Additional Company Holidays</li>
<li>Enhanced Parental Leave</li>
<li>Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break</li>
</ul>
<p><em>*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*</em></p>
<p><strong>Culture Values</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make Bold Bets:</strong> We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.</li>
<li><strong>Innovate with Insight:</strong> We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive&nbsp;powerful outcomes.</li>
<li><strong>One Team:</strong> We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.</li>
<li><strong>Candor with Connection:</strong> We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.</li>
<li><strong>Champion the Customer:</strong> We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.</li>
<li><strong>Powerful Simplicity:</strong> We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Why choose Mixpanel?</strong></p>
<p>We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.</p>
<p><span>Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.</span></p></div>
